title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Evaluate privacy risks in policies and terms of service. Check for dark patterns, data sharing risks, and unclear consent mechanisms.
description: Assess the privacy risks in any privacy policy or terms of service agreement. This calculator helps you identify red flags, dark patterns, and potential data misuse by analyzing key policy elements and transparency factors.

inputs.label: Policy Length (pages)
inputs.helpText: How many pages long is the privacy policy or terms of service?

inputs.label: Reading Level Required
inputs.helpText: What education level is needed to understand the policy?

inputs.label: Third-Party Data Sharing
inputs.helpText: How does the policy describe sharing your data with third parties?

inputs.label: Consent Type
inputs.helpText: How does the service obtain your consent?

inputs.label: Opt-Out Difficulty
inputs.helpText: Rate how difficult it is to opt out or delete your data (1=easy, 5=very hard)

inputs.label: Policy Change Notification
inputs.helpText: How are you notified when the policy changes?

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall privacy risk rating from 0-100 (higher = more risk)

outputFields.label: Risk Grade
outputFields.description: Letter grade assessment of privacy protection

formula: const lengthScore = Math.min(policyLength * 2, 20); const readabilityScores = {middle: 0, high: 5, college: 10, graduate: 20}; const sharingScores = {none: 0, clear: 5, vague: 15, broad: 25}; const consentScores = {explicit: 0, checkbox: 10, implied: 20, bundled: 25}; const changeScores = {direct: 0, email: 5, website: 15, none: 25}; const riskScore = Math.min(lengthScore + readabilityScores[readabilityLevel] + sharingScores[dataSharing] + consentScores[consentMechanism] + (optOutDifficulty * 4) + changeScores[policyChanges], 100); const grades = riskScore <= 20 ? 'A': riskScore <= 40 ? 'B': riskScore <= 60 ? 'C': riskScore <= 80 ? 'D': 'F'; const darkPatternRisk = Math.min(((consentScores[consentMechanism] + (optOutDifficulty * 5) + (readabilityScores[readabilityLevel] / 2)) / 45) * 100, 100); return {riskScore: Math.round(riskScore), riskGrade: grades, darkPatternRisk: Math.round(darkPatternRisk)};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates privacy policies and terms of service based on transparency, user control, consent mechanisms, and accessibility. Higher scores indicate greater privacy risks, including potential for data misuse, difficult opt-outs, and manipulative design patterns.
tips: Look for policies under 10 pages - longer policies often hide important details in legal jargon
Avoid services that use pre-checked consent boxes or bundle all permissions together
Check if you can easily delete your account and data - difficult opt-outs are red flags
Use a privacy-focused browser to read policies without being tracked by the same company
Watch for vague language about 'partners' or 'affiliates' - this often means broad data sharing

interpretation.label: Low Risk (A)
interpretation.description: Good privacy protection with clear policies and user control

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk (B)
interpretation.description: Reasonable privacy but some concerning practices

interpretation.label: Elevated Risk (C)
interpretation.description: Several privacy concerns and potential for data misuse

interpretation.label: High Risk (D)
interpretation.description: Significant privacy risks and poor user control

interpretation.label: Very High Risk (F)
interpretation.description: Major privacy concerns with likely dark patterns
